title: Mud on the step
logline: The garage's one step in November with the pup's two-one prints in mud on it, drying, and a boot print over them. The step, close. The book's smallest page about the walk.

panels.composition: Close on a single concrete step at a garage door with a three-legged dog's muddy prints drying on it and one boot print laid over them, rain at the edge.
